capabilities.name: Create open save and close game project
capabilities.description: Create and persist native Game Studio projects.

capabilities.name: Scene creation and scene graph
capabilities.description: Create game scenes and maintain scene/entity hierarchy.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.8.1 — Project scenes entities components inspectors and assets
capabilities.notes: Scene creation and runtime scene state exist; instancing, inheritance, transitions, and dependencies remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Entity and component architecture
capabilities.description: Create entities and add, update, enable, disable, remove, and inspect reusable components.
capabilities.notes: Runtime component foundations include transform, sprite, collider, rigidbody, script, camera, audio, and custom components.

capabilities.name: Game runtime engine
capabilities.description: Initialize runtime state, load scenes, select entities, update runtime status, and advance runtime time.
capabilities.notes: This marks the runtime foundation complete, not the entire production runtime.

capabilities.name: Preview and play controls
capabilities.description: Start preview/play mode and pause, resume, step, stop, and reset runtime execution.

capabilities.name: Game asset browser and import pipeline
capabilities.description: Import, browse, inspect, reimport, track, and link game assets.
capabilities.notes: Asset linking was explicitly absent from Stage 3.

capabilities.name: 2D scene editor
capabilities.description: Provide interactive 2D scene assembly with transforms, snapping, guides, overlays, colliders, and cameras.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.8.2 — 2D/3D editing prefabs tilemaps level design and rendering

capabilities.name: 3D scene editor
capabilities.description: Provide interactive 3D scene assembly with transforms, cameras, lighting, snapping, colliders, and overlays.

capabilities.name: Prefabs and reusable scenes
capabilities.description: Create reusable scenes and prefabs with variants, inheritance, and overrides.

capabilities.name: Tilemap and level-design tools
capabilities.description: Provide tilesets, tilemaps, autotiling, and common 2D level-design workflows.

capabilities.name: Game rendering systems
capabilities.description: Support materials, shaders, lighting, post-processing, and particles for game scenes.

capabilities.name: Code scripting
capabilities.description: Attach and execute lifecycle-aware game scripts with inspector-exposed properties and debugging.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.8.3 — Scripting visual scripting events input physics and controllers
capabilities.notes: Script components exist as a data/runtime foundation, but execution and IDE integration are unfinished.

capabilities.name: Visual scripting
capabilities.description: Create visual logic graphs with execution flow and runtime tracing.

capabilities.name: Events signals and input
capabilities.description: Provide signals/events, input maps, user remapping, and gameplay event routing.

capabilities.name: Game physics
capabilities.description: Support 2D/3D bodies, colliders, joints, physics debugging, and character controllers.
capabilities.notes: Collider and rigidbody component contracts exist, but a complete physics runtime does not.

capabilities.name: Gameplay animation systems
capabilities.description: Provide animation playback, state machines, blends, animation events, and cross-slice animation clips.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.8.4 — Animation UI audio navigation AI behavior and data-driven systems

capabilities.name: Game UI system
capabilities.description: Create runtime UI controls, layouts, themes, canvases, and input behavior.

capabilities.name: Game audio system
capabilities.description: Provide audio sources, buses, zones, mixing, and runtime audio behavior.
capabilities.notes: Audio component contracts exist; production audio runtime is incomplete.

capabilities.name: Navigation and pathfinding
capabilities.description: Provide navigation data, pathfinding, and navigation-aware runtime behavior.

capabilities.name: Data-driven gameplay systems
capabilities.description: Provide structured editors and validation for items, enemies, quests, dialogue, economy, and other gameplay data.

capabilities.name: Runtime save and load
capabilities.description: Provide versioned and atomic runtime save/load data with migrations.
capabilities.source: Wave 1.8.5 — Save/load localization testing debugging profiling and optimization

capabilities.name: Runtime diagnostics
capabilities.description: Expose runtime mode, clock, active scene, selection, components, warnings, and diagnostic state.
capabilities.notes: Current debug drawer exposes engine/runtime diagnostics.

capabilities.name: Testing debugging and profiling
capabilities.description: Provide runtime inspection, debugger, console, automated tests, profiler, and performance diagnostics.
capabilities.notes: Runtime diagnostics exist, but full debugger/tests/profiler workflows remain incomplete.

capabilities.name: Game build and export pipeline
capabilities.description: Build, package, and export playable game projects for supported targets.
capabilities.source: PL Game Dev Studio / Build and Export
capabilities.notes: Stage 3 explicitly lists export/build pipeline as missing.

capabilities.name: Cross-slice game workflows
capabilities.description: Consume Code scripts, Modeler assets, Animation clips, Docs design data, and Sheets game data through project-aware links.
capabilities.source: PL Game Dev Studio / Cross-Slice Workflows

capabilities.name: Game development AI proposals
capabilities.description: Provide permissioned and reviewable AI assistance for game logic, data, scenes, diagnostics, and development tasks.
capabilities.source: PL Game Dev Studio / Project-Aware AI Assistance

capabilities.name: Game project autosave and recovery
capabilities.description: Provide project snapshots, autosave, recovery, and safe migration behavior.
